coverageNotes: Measures optional intermediate fields when adding/removing columns; migration helpers, patch semantics and full deployment sequencing remain unconverted. Measures old/new value compatibility in the same field; does not establish transformation correctness, idempotency or deployment sequencing.

questions.context: Using Convex SDK 1.44.0, existing product rows have a string `category` and no `description`. During migration, new rows may add a string `description` and may omit `category`. Both fields, when present, must be strings. All other product fields stay fixed. `v` is imported from `convex/values`.
questions.question: Which intermediate field mapping accepts old, partially migrated and fully migrated rows?

options.rationale: Requiring description rejects old rows where it is absent.
Making each field optional permits both transition states while validating present strings.
Requiring category rejects rows after category has been removed.
A nullable description is still required and also admits null, outside the contract.

questions.context: Using Convex SDK 1.44.0, old product rows store booleans in required `active`. During migration, that same field must also accept exactly the strings `"active"`, `"inactive"`, and `"banned"`. Missing values and other values must be rejected. `v` is imported from `convex/values`.
questions.question: Which intermediate validator supports both old and migrated rows?

options.rationale: A new-only literal union rejects existing boolean values.
Optionality allows omission but still rejects existing boolean values.
The union accepts the old boolean representation and exactly the three new statuses.
The broad string validator also accepts statuses outside the requested set.
